# Fizzl Agent Wallet

> A wallet for AI agents that pay: the agent pays for x402 APIs and sends USDC within spending limits its owner sets, and asks the owner for approval on their phone (Telegram) or the dashboard above them. Every signature is checked by presign-guard first, every purchase gets a receipt (what was bought, from whom, for how much, and whether it was delivered), and per-agent mandates cap what each agent may buy. Pays x402 in USDC on Base, and with the MCP server also on Solana, Algorand, the XRP Ledger (RLUSD) and Tempo. Free to start; Pro is $5 a month for unlimited agents, and includes Fizzl Pass Bronze: anyone can check whether a wallet has a pass, for free, at GET https://wallet.fizzl.eu/v1/pass/status?wallet=<address> (tier and end date only, never whose it is), and the owner gets a signed proof (Ed25519, public key at https://wallet.fizzl.eu/.well-known/fizzl-pass.json). Fizzl Pass Silver ($20 for 90 days) and Gold ($60 for 180 days) include Pro. On Fizzl's own services (x402 Doctor, presign-guard, Ichimoku Signal, Fizzl Buy) the pass gives 5, 10 or 25 times the free limits (Bronze, Silver, Gold) and 10, 20 or 30% of every paid call back as credit in the pass's vault; a call with the proof in the `X-Fizzl-Pass` header and no payment is paid from that vault when it holds enough (pay_x402 then answers `paid_from_vault`). An agent can also buy a pass for its own wallet over x402, without an account: GET https://x402-doctor.fizzl.eu/api/v1/pass/bronze ($5, 30 days), /silver ($20, 90 days) or /gold ($60, 180 days); the answer's claim_url returns the signed proof once the payment has settled. What the pass gives, and how a seller checks it or verifies its proof offline to give pass holders its own terms: https://wallet.fizzl.eu/pass Running the wallet yourself (presign-guard-wallet 0.20+, or the MCP server with your own limits and `AC2_OWNER`), approvals above the limits can instead be signed in the owner's own wallet (AC2 Wallet) over AC2, the Algorand Foundation's protocol for agents to ask their owner; the signed approval is kept with the payment.

The agent connects by reading the setup instructions in skill.md; the owner signs in with a wallet (MetaMask, Coinbase Wallet, Phantom, Xaman, Pera, Defly) or a passkey. Includes a catalog of paid x402 services and a free endpoint monitor for sellers.

## For agents
- [Setup and usage instructions (skill.md)](https://wallet.fizzl.eu/skill.md): walk the owner through setup, then pay with `pay_x402`
- MCP server: [presign-guard-wallet-mcp](https://www.npmjs.com/package/presign-guard-wallet-mcp) on npm, for Claude, Cursor and other MCP clients
- Remote connector for ChatGPT, Claude (web, desktop, phone) and Grok: https://wallet.fizzl.eu/mcp (OAuth; the app asks for payments, the owner signs each one in their own wallet: USDC on Base or Solana, or RLUSD in Xaman). [How to add it](https://wallet.fizzl.eu/connector)
- Library: [presign-guard-wallet](https://www.npmjs.com/package/presign-guard-wallet) on npm, with integrations for Coinbase AgentKit, the AI SDK, LangChain and the Solana Agent Kit
- Agent skill: `npx skills add Fizzl13/fizzl-skills`, or in Claude Code `/plugin marketplace add Fizzl13/x402-doctor` then `/plugin install fizzl-agent-wallet@fizzl`. Every Fizzl skill: https://github.com/Fizzl13/fizzl-skills

## For owners
- [Dashboard](https://wallet.fizzl.eu/): limits, approvals, receipts, agents and mandates
- [Privacy](https://wallet.fizzl.eu/privacy) and [terms](https://wallet.fizzl.eu/terms)
- [Fizzl Agent Wallet and Coinbase for Agents](https://wallet.fizzl.eu/compare/coinbase): the difference with the Coinbase MCP and the Coinbase Wallet MCP (who holds the money, approvals, daily budgets, networks, checks), checked 23 October 2026

## Optional
- [Fizzl](https://fizzl.eu/llms.txt): the other Fizzl services (x402 Doctor, pre-sign checks, trading signals)
